rows.us_landed_label: Lowest US-filter card price with sales for a cordless 150 PSI digital inflator, free shipping, no new-shopper tag (listing 3256813094620129, 16 sold). Battery size is not in the title; the larger-battery unit comparable to Airmoto's and Fanttik's reads $49.09. A card at $8.25 with no sales was ignored. VERIFIED as displayed on the AliExpress search card with the ship-from United States filter on, read 2026-11-21 in a headless browser. rows.cn_landed_label: UNKNOWN. China-side cards read $10.68 to $13.41 with 772 to 1K+ sold, all with new-shopper tags; ship-from and delivery days not shown.

Airmoto is a DTC single-product brand built on paid ads (1.5 million units claimed, 10,000+ a month on Amazon at $59.49); Fanttik is a large Amazon and TikTok Shop brand (8,100+ units a month here, 1,315 reviews on its own site). A no-name inflator competes on the same promise at the same price.

Do not use the Airmoto or Fanttik names, their product shapes or their images. No patent check was done on the handheld form; Airmoto's page should be checked for patent markings before any look-alike is sold.
